note: Independent rejudgment 2026-11-22 after Router Key (type 9) handling was added to RTRSession.handlePDU. RFC 6810 Section 7 requires unprotected TCP transport on port rpki-rtr (323) carrying this document's version-0 binary PDUs. Ze implements unprotected TCP defaulting to port 323, but current handlePDU still rejects initial version-0 PDUs and refuses version-0 downgrade (rtrVersionMin=1), and syncOnce never establishes a version below 1. Adding pduRouterKey handling in handlePDU adds no version-0 protocol support. No test carries this id; the row remains unimplemented.
